Lane f041, 2026-10-19: implemented, not yet claimed (the claim gate needs the LLM, capped until 17:00 PDT). Local commit 914beb80203 on origin/main c0cf1022671, pushed as Gerrit 3055 in WIP (hashtag rebar-session-lane-e045) so CI's Verified lane runs early; it stays WIP until this story is claimed.

AC grep (the AC8 command), both runs over `src/rebar tests scripts .github docs README.md AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md templates examples`, excluding `docs/archive docs/experiments docs/adr docs/release-notes.md tests/fixtures`:
git grep -n -P "(?<![\w.\-])(?<!from )rebar (fsck-recover|fsck|doctor|tracker-maintenance|tracker-footprint|export|import|compact-all|compact)(?![\w\-])"
- PRE-edit on c0cf1022671: 202 lines (src/rebar 91 including the 9 committed help artifacts, docs 66 including the generated cli-reference, tests 37, .github 3, README 1, AGENTS.md 1, examples/mcp-clients 3).
- POST-edit on 914beb80203: 0 lines. The removed-spelling registry stores bare keys (`"fsck": "rebar store fsck"`), and its parametrized test builds the `rebar <old>` hint string at run time, so neither matches.

Test-call retarget (AST rewrite of the inventory): 66 call sites in scripts/probe_rebar.py and 18 test files, plus hand edits in test_cli_registry.py, test_cli_registry_dispatch.py, test_core_cli_parsers.py, test_cli_registry_full_extra.py, test_schema_coverage.py, tests/scripts/graph/test_doctor.py, test_gen_cli_help.py and test_scan_scoping.py (the last two read the deleted import.txt/fsck.txt/compact-all.txt artifacts and now read the rendered `store <member> --help`). New tests/unit/test_store_family.py covers the family usage errors, help, per-member init policy (8 rows through store_cli), the footprint mount carve-out, compact arm selection and the sweep-only-flag error, and `store compact --all --dry-run` output equal to the sweep entry's.

Local results: make lint and make typecheck pass (complexity active=28 new=0 increased=0; mechanism new=0 unadmitted). Touched unit/interface tests pass, 770+ in one run; the 4 integration-tier files touched pass (49 tests); scripts/probe_rebar.py 142 passed, 0 failed; the generators (gen_cli_help, gen_cli_reference, gen_env_registry, gen_config_reference, check_docs_index, gen_api_surface, gen_mcp_reference) all pass --check. make verify is running.

One addition beyond the plan text: `store compact --all <id>` exits 1 with "unknown option", exactly as `compact-all <id>` did, because the sweep arm receives the same argv the old spelling received.
